summary: Practise data mapping, privacy risk reviews and incident workflows in a five-day data protection course. Explore the curriculum and outcomes.
lede: Data protection covers mapping how personal information is collected, used, shared, retained and safeguarded. For privacy officers, records specialists and operational leads, the course focuses on reviewing everyday data handling and strengthening practical controls. You will map data flows, assess privacy risks, review access and retention, check supplier hand-offs and practise incident escalation, producing work products such as a data inventory, risk register and response workflow.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who handle, safeguard, review or report on personal information as part of their work.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with workplace records or personal information handling is expected. No coding or programming is required.
